about: Hand-fixed part breakdowns. tools/build_data.py uses these instead of its own split. Each part is [glyph, position], or [glyph, position, [KanjiVG stroke numbers]] when the glyph needs a drawing; glyphs must be palette tiles or their forms (data/parts.json), positions one of left, right, top, bottom, outer, inner, whole, none. Say why, so the next person knows what KanjiVG got wrong.

万.why: The two strokes under the line draw 力; KanjiVG leaves them loose.

円.why: The stroke and line sit inside 冂; KanjiVG gives no positions, so they came out none.

年.why: KanjiVG splits 干 around the other strokes, which left loose strokes and an enclosure.

寒.why: The middle is 共 with an extra line; KanjiVG has it as loose strokes and a split 三.

声.why: KanjiVG leaves the bottom as four loose strokes; it reads as 尸 with a stroke down its left.

勤.why: KanjiVG's 菫 isn't a tile and its bottom is loose strokes; it draws 口 over 王.

無.why: KanjiVG leaves the top as eight loose strokes. 卌 isn't in JIS, so its strokes are listed for the drawing.

舞.why: Same top as 無, which KanjiVG leaves as loose strokes.

産.why: 立 over 厂 and 生: the stroke down the left and 立's last line draw 厂; KanjiVG leaves the stroke loose.

着.why: 羊 over 目; the long stroke is part of 羊 here, and KanjiVG leaves it loose.

表.why: KanjiVG splits 衣 around 龶, which left 二 and a loose stroke on top.

号.why: The bottom is 丂; KanjiVG leaves it as a line and a loose stroke.

母.why: 母 has two dots, not 毋's stroke: it shows as 母, a form of the 毋 tile (毎 海 keep 毋).

内.why: 人 sits inside 冂; KanjiVG gives no positions, so they came out top and bottom.

両.why: 一 over 冂 holding 山; KanjiVG gives no positions, so they came out none.

画.why: 一 over 由 held in 凵; KanjiVG gives no positions, so they came out none.

在.why: ナ's line on top, with its stroke and a vertical drawing 亻 under it and 土 to the right; KanjiVG's split put 一 and 亻 both on top.

存.why: Same shape as 在, with 子 for 土; KanjiVG's split made 一 and 亻 an enclosure.

乗.why: 禾 (the top stroke and line, the long vertical and the two legs) with 廿 across its middle, where the old 乘 had 北; KanjiVG leaves the middle as five loose strokes.

謄.why: 月 beside 𠔉 over 言, as 騰 is 月 beside 𠔉 over 馬; KanjiVG splits 朕 across the two sides, which left loose strokes.

塞.why: The middle is 共 with an extra line, as in 寒; KanjiVG has it as loose strokes.

僅.why: The right is 廿 over 口 over 王, as 勤 is 艹 over 口 over 王; KanjiVG leaves 口 and 王 as loose strokes.

謹.why: The right is 艹 over 口 over 王, as in 勤; KanjiVG leaves 口 and 王 as loose strokes.

衆.why: 血 over 乑, as dictionaries split it; KanjiVG leaves the bottom as 亻 and four loose strokes. 乑 is only here, so its strokes are listed for its stroke count.

脊.why: The top is a roof with 二 on each side, over 月; KanjiVG's 人 overlaps the 二s, so the roof wasn't found.

茶.why: 艹 over a roof over 木 (9 strokes). The build found 余, which makes 荼, a different kanji.

曜.why: The jōyō 曜 has ヨヨ over 隹, not 羽 (習 keeps 羽); KanjiVG names the top 羽.

躍.why: The jōyō 躍 has ヨヨ over 隹, not 羽 (習 keeps 羽); KanjiVG names the top 羽.

濯.why: The jōyō 濯 has ヨヨ over 隹, not 羽 (習 keeps 羽); KanjiVG names the top 羽.

周.why: The lower line inside is the longer: 土, not 士. KanjiVG names it 吉.

週.why: 周 is 冂 holding 土 and 口, not 士.

調.why: 周 is 冂 holding 土 and 口, not 士.

彫.why: 周 is 冂 holding 土 and 口, not 士.

令.why: Printed fonts (Noto, which the game loads) draw 令's foot as 卩; マ is the handwritten form.

冷.why: 令 as printed: 𠆢 一 卩.

鈴.why: 令 as printed: 𠆢 一 卩.

零.why: 令 as printed: 𠆢 一 卩.

南.why: The inside is the 𢆉 of 幸 and 報, one tile in both.

献.why: 南 holds 𢆉, as 幸 and 報 do.

卵.why: 卵 has two dots; KanjiVG counts one of them inside 卯.

良.why: The top stroke is written and taught as a dot.

娘.why: 良's top stroke is a dot.

慈.why: 茲's top is 丷 over 一, not 艹, over 幺 twice; KanjiVG names the top 艹.

滋.why: 茲's top is 丷 over 一, not 艹, over 幺 twice.

磁.why: 茲's top is 丷 over 一, not 艹, over 幺 twice.

左.why: ナ over 工, as 右 is ナ over 口; an enclosure place read oddly in Guided.

友.why: ナ over 又, as 有 is ナ over 月.

者.why: 耂 is a crown, not an enclosure.

考.why: 耂 is a crown, not an enclosure.

貫.why: 貫's top is 毌 (a straight vertical), not 毋. 毌 is only here and in 慣, so its strokes are listed for its stroke count.

慣.why: 貫's top is 毌, not 毋.
